headline_marked: Student [[killed by friend for ransom]], body found in carton in Nilphamari
headline: Student killed by friend for ransom, body found in carton in Nilphamari
summary: A 17-year-old student was abducted and murdered by an acquaintance in Dhaka, with his body transported in a carton to be buried in a betel nut garden.
details: Rakibul Islam, a 17-year-old student from Tangail, had moved to Dhaka a month prior to prepare for university admission tests. He disappeared after being called by an acquaintance, Abdullah Al Mamun (24), on September 16.

Police investigation revealed that Rakibul was taken to a house in Shukrubad, Dhaka, where he was killed. The suspect, Mamun, allegedly strangled the teenager during a struggle after attempting to pressure him for ransom money.

To hide the crime, Mamun packed the body into a carton, sealed it with scotch tape, and transported it via auto-rickshaw and bus from Gabtoli to Nilphamari. He buried the body in a betel nut garden in Dimla, Nilphamari.

Before the murder, Mamun had contacted the victim's family via WhatsApp, demanding 15 lakh BDT. The family, hoping to see Rakibul alive, sent a total of 4 lakh BDT through various mobile banking services.
The mystery was solved after Rakibul's brother filed a missing person's report (GD) at Kafrul Police Station. Police subsequently arrested Mamun on October 5 from the Shukrubad bus stand area.
Following the arrest, police recovered the body from the body from the betel nut garden on October 6. Only 50,000 BDT of the ransom money was recovered by the police.

Before the murder, Mamun had contacted the victim's family via WhatsApp, demanding 15 lakh BDT. The family, hoping to see Rakibul alive, sent a total of 4 lakh BDT through various mobile banking services.

The mystery was solved after Rakibul's brother filed a missing person's report (GD) at Kafrul Police Station. Police subsequently arrested Mamun on October 5 from the Shukrubad bus stand area.

headline_marked: 5 arrested after [[13-month-old baby sold for 2 lakh BDT]] in Mymensingh
headline: 5 arrested after 13-month-old baby sold for 2 lakh BDT in Mymensingh
summary: The child was allegedly sold by his father and grandparents; police rescued the infant from Dhaka's Dohar upazila.
details: Police have arrested five people, including the child's grandfather and grandmother, for allegedly selling a 13-month-old baby for 2 lakh BDT in Mymensingh's Ishwarganj upazila.
The infant, named Mozahid, Mozahid's mother, Rozina Begum, filed a case under the Prevention and Suppression of Human Trafficking Act after discovering the child had been sold.
According to the case, Rozina was beaten and sent to her father's house five months ago due to family disputes, while the baby remained with the paternal grandparents.
Rozina learned through local sources that on September 28, her husband and in-laws sold the baby to unidentified persons for 2 lakh BDT.
Following a General Diary (GD) filed by the mother, Ishwarganj police tracked the child to the Harichandi area of Dohar upazila in Dhaka.
The baby was rescued from a couple who claimed they took the child to raise as their own because they had no children of their own, though the process was illegal.
The arrested individuals include the grandfather Ujjwal Mia, grandmother Aisha Khatun, aunt Sharifa Khatun, and the couple from Dohar, Abed Molla and Shikha.
Ishwarganj Police Station OC Sajjad Roman confirmed that the child is safe and will be handed over to the mother through the court.
